description: Paste any text to find the most-used words with counts and bar-chart visualization.

faqs.a: A word is any run of letters plus apostrophes (so "don't" counts as one word). Numbers and punctuation are ignored.
Stopwords are the most common filler words like "the", "and" and "is". Removing them surfaces the meaningful content words in your text.
Yes. Everything runs in your browser with JavaScript — your text is never sent to any server.

howto: Paste or type your text into the text area.
Set a minimum word length and choose whether to ignore case and remove stopwords.
Click "Analyze" to see the top 30 words.
Hover or read the counts and bars to spot which words dominate your text.
title: Word Frequency Counter
